card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'feelings' or 'emotions', such as 'express', 'similar', 'painful' or 'communicate'. It also fires on the start of words beginning with 's' where a sympathy or feeling word may follow, like 's' in sapphism or 'uns' in unsympathetic.

modes.label: Before feelings/emotions
modes.description: A verb or adjective that sets up the noun 'feelings' or 'emotions' next.

modes.label: Start of s- words
modes.description: The first piece of a rare word starting with s, such as a name or sympathy-related word.

card.writes: It pushes toward emotion-related continuations and away from English words like feelings, emotions and sentiment.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say 'feelings' or 'emotions', and sometimes on the start of odd s-words.
